conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Officer Daniel Brooks speaking. This call is regarding your federal tax filings. May I have your full name for verification?
Yes, hello, my name is Priya Sharma. I received a message telling me to urgently call this number about my taxes.

Thank you, Ms. Sharma. For your reference, my badge number is IRM-54218. I am contacting you about discrepancies in your 2021 and 2022 federal tax returns. Are you aware of any errors in your filings?
No, I always use an accountant. I don't understand what could be wrong.

According to our audit, there are unresolved discrepancies amounting to $3,900 in back taxes and penalties. This case has been escalated to the Enforcement Division, and a warrant for your arrest was generated this morning.
Wait, what? Arrest? I never received anything about this. Are you sure?

Ms. Sharma, this is a serious legal matter. If the warrant proceeds, law enforcement will detain you for federal tax evasion, and your bank accounts could be frozen. I am legally required to inform you of these consequences.
Oh my god, I just started my new job. I can't be arrested. What am I supposed to do?
You have been granted a one-time opportunity to resolve this before your case is finalized in court. To stop the legal action, you must settle the outstanding tax liability immediately.
I don't have nearly $4,000 in my account right now. How can I pay this?

We can accept payment in two parts today. The first installment should be made to the IRS Treasury holding account. For security reasons, we only accept payments through Bitcoin or government-approved gift cards. Which method can you arrange fastest?
I've never used Bitcoin. I don't know how to do that. I could get gift cards maybe. What kind do I need?
You need to purchase Target, Apple, or Best Buy gift cards totaling $1,500 for the initial payment. Once you have them, read the card numbers to me for verification.
Okay, but I have to go to the store, right? I don't have those cards at home.
Correct. Please stay on the line while you go to the nearest store. This call must be recorded as proof of your compliance for the IRS.
That will take me maybe 15 minutes. Are you sure this is the only way?
If you disconnect or fail to comply, the warrant will be activated and law enforcement notified. Do you understand the seriousness of the situation, Ms. Sharma?
Yes, I don't want any trouble. I will go now. What do I do after I buy them?
Immediately scratch the silver strip on the back of each card and read the codes to me. I will confirm receipt and update your IRS compliance file.
Okay, I will get the cards. Should I buy all Target cards, or mix them?
Any combination is acceptable, as long as the total is $1,500. Remember, you must not share these codes with anyone else or your payment won't be valid for your tax case.
Alright. I'm leaving now. Please don't tell the police.
As long as you follow my instructions, the arrest warrant will remain on hold. I am here to assist you through this process and prevent further action.
